assumptions: Imitation targets come from a BFS expert that sees the whole map; the policy sees only the view cone, heading, collision flag, elapsed time, token, rule-change flag and cue. After a warm start on demonstrations, half of the training episodes are the policy's own rollouts labelled by the expert (DAgger); at evaluation the expert only scores.
Seen maps are training map seeds; unseen maps are even seeds that training never draws.
The rewired control keeps parameter count, update budget and every node's recurrent in/out degree; it tests whether this particular wiring matters, not the fly connectome.
